text.title: Stakeholder Management Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example: inputs → procedure steps → final artefact matching the JSON Schema in 02-output-contract.xml. Then: Stakeholder register column schema, communication plan matrix, meeting template structure, and worked examples for both SaaS feature launch and solo product contexts. The column schema is rule register-columns-with-owner in 01-core-rules.xml.

section.title: Inputs (mocked)
section.note: Pulled per `## Prerequisites`; sources cited in `01-core-rules.xml` rationale.

section.title: Step-by-step application
section.note: 1. Preconditions check: all `## Applies If` items satisfied; no `## Skip If` items fired.
2. Inputs gathered from named sources; freshness OK.
4. Artefact produced from `templates/` rendered with real values (see Final Artefact below).

example.title: Communication plan matrix
example.note: Executive sponsor: status + decisions, weekly, 1:1 meeting, PM owns
Dev team: requirements + changes, daily, stand-up, PM owns
Sales team: features + timeline, bi-weekly, email update, PM owns
Customers: releases + feedback, monthly, newsletter, Marketing owns

section.title: Worked registers

example.title: SaaS feature launch
example.note: SaaS feature launch (5+ stakeholders): CEO (High/Medium → Keep Satisfied, quarterly), Head of Sales (High/High → Partner, weekly sync), Engineering Lead (Medium/High → Involved, daily standups), Key Customer (Low/High → Informed, beta access), Support Team (Low/High → Involved, training sessions). Explicit owner assigned to each row.

example.title: Solo product stakeholder register
example.note: Solo product stakeholder register: Early customers (need working product + support → Discord and email), Payment processor (need compliance → documentation), Hosting provider (need technical requirements → support tickets), Advisor/mentor (need progress → monthly call), Family (need time boundaries → clear schedule). Even solopreneurs have stakeholders requiring explicit engagement plans.

example.title: Register that produces no value
example.note: Register with attitude column left blank for all rows, owner column filled with "team", and cadence listed as "ad-hoc". This register produces no value — attitude Unknown rows never get escalated, no one owns relationships, and "ad-hoc" means nothing happens.
